description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about who can ask for changes on a booking.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about who can ask for changes on a booking, last updated between 2026-05-26 and 2026-06-30. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Travel managers listed on a company account may act on its bookings."; "travel managers listed on the company account"; "This applies to every request handled from July 1, whatever the date of the flight."; "only the booking contact"; "listed travel managers may act for the company's travellers". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
